title: Mobile Device Management Policy
definition: Maintain a Mobile Device Management (MDM) system to enforce cybersecurity safeguards on each organizational mobile device, such as phones and tablets.

title: Mobile Device Management Policy
definition: Ensure the Mobile Device Management (MDM) system limits enterprise data on mobile devices to containerized, enterprise-managed applications.

title: Mobile Device Management Policy
definition: Ensure the Mobile Device Management (MDM) system enforces approved configurations on each approved enterprise application.

title: Mobile Device Management Policy
definition: Ensure the Mobile Device Management (MDM) system enforces application control on managed mobile devices, allowing only authorized applications, including mobile application stores, to execute.

title: Mobile Device Management Policy
definition: Ensure the Mobile Device Management (MDM) system enforces an unlock code of six characters or longer to access each mobile device.

title: Mobile Device Management Policy
definition: Ensure the Mobile Device Management (MDM) system enforces mobile operating system updates on each mobile device.

title: Mobile Device Management Policy
definition: Ensure the Mobile Device Management (MDM) system enforces application updates on each mobile device.

title: Mobile Device Management Policy
definition: Ensure the Mobile Device Management (MDM) system detects and blocks attempts to jailbreak or root mobile devices.

title: Mobile Device Management Policy
definition: Ensure the Mobile Device Management (MDM) system can remotely wipe data from mobile devices if they are lost or stolen.
